lesson: In the redact function, never mask email keys even though they were initially proposed as sensitive.
why: Customer support relies on looking up customers by email to answer tickets.
quote: First, do NOT mask email — support answers tickets by looking customers up by email

lesson: In redact, match sensitive keys by suffix after lowercasing and replacing non-alphanumeric sequences with underscores, rather than matching on substring containment.
why: Substring containment is too broad, and normalization ensures formats like X-Api-Key match the api_key suffix correctly.
quote: Second, 'contains' is too broad; match on how the key ends.

lesson: In redact, keys ending in card_number must be masked as '***' followed by the last 4 digits instead of a full replacement with '***'.
why: Customer support requires the trailing 4 digits to reconcile chargeback disputes.
quote: support reconciles chargeback disputes by the tail digits, so a full mask breaks them.
